item.title: Iran, Kazakhstan stress expansion of ICT cooperation
item.description: Iran and Kazakhstan have stressed the need to expand bilateral and regional cooperation in communications and information technology.

item.title: Iran, Uzbekistan stress expansion of rail, road, transit cooperation
item.description: Iran and Uzbekistan have emphasized the need to expand transport cooperation, facilitate transit and strengthen regional trade and logistics links.

item.title: Two more tankers catch fire after striking mine in Strait of Hormuz: Iran’s Army
item.description: The Iranian Army Navy stresses that responsibility for the tankers catching fire in the prohibited area rests “first and foremost with the lying president of the United States.

item.title: IRGC smashes armed team of PJAK terrorist group in northwest Iran
item.description: The IRGC Ground Force has dismantled a two-member cell of the PJAK separatist terror group during a counterterrorism operation in northwestern Iran.

item.title: Iran, Brazil presidents discuss expanding bilateral ties, strengthening economic cooperation
item.description: Iranian and Brazilian presidents have stressed the need to expand bilateral ties and strengthen economic cooperation.

item.title: Rapid reconstruction of Iran's industries changed how world sees Iran: Diplomat
item.description: Iran's Ambassador to Russia tells Iranian mining and steel executives that all war damage has been repaired by domestic engineers.

item.title: Iran lost 28% of gas production in three minutes during March attacks: NIGC chief
item.description: Saeed Tavakoli says 26 projectiles struck six gas refineries, describing it as the largest gas incident in the world, but says the network was restored within 24 hours.

item.title: Army chief: Enemy will face heavier losses in case of new attack on Iran
item.description: Iran’s Army chief says the enemy is far from invincible, despite its efforts to project an image of an overwhelming power.

item.title: Iran slams Western media for ignoring Israel’s ‘silent genocide’ in Gaza
item.description: Iran's FM says the disastrous situation in Gaza is no longer making headlines in Western media.

item.title: UN General Assembly elects Iran to key committee shaping global human rights policy
item.description: The General Assembly elects Iran to the United Nations committee with influence on the shaping of policy concerning human rights.

item.title: Iran: US seeking to portray itself as victim with claims of ‘threat’ against Bessent
item.description: Iran categorically rejects Washington’s claims that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was relocated to a military base over alleged “threats” to his life linked to the Islamic Republic.

item.title: Iran to strike any location worldwide used to launch attacks against it: Senior commander
item.description: Deputy Chief of Staff of Iran’s Armed Forces says any location anywhere in the world from which hostile activity or an attack against the country originates will face a crushing response.

item.title: Chilean truck drivers protest against rising fuel prices
item.description: Truck drivers organized protests in the Chilean capital, Santiago, against the significant rise in fuel prices.

item.title: One dead, multiple injured in Washington DC shooting
item.description: Five people were shot early Thursday in a trendy Washington, D.C., neighborhood within walking distance of the White House.

item.title: Israeli bulldozers demolish homes in southern Lebanon
item.description: In a further escalation of its aggression, occupation bulldozers continue to demolish citizens' homes in the occupied eastern town of Zawtar in southern Lebanon
